_about: Values the MEASURED claims cite, extracted from raw logs kept outside the repository (default evidence directory: ~/project/shared/containers/runs/paper-evidence/flywheel). Each run names its log, the log's sha256, the brain commit and the exact command. `build_data.py --check --evidence DIR` re-extracts every value from DIR/<log> and compares; without DIR only this file is read.
